headline: Mining the road ahead

highlights: Notably, the awarding has improved recently, on the back of which, KNR is targeting INR 50bn order inflow (OI) in H2FY27.
However, the quarter was marred by weak execution, with revenue at INR 4.8bn (-3% YoY), and EBITDA of INR 0.4bn (-18% YoY), with margin of 9.2% (-166bps YoY), while HAM sales lifted the reported PAT.
Management has maintained its revenue guidance of INR 22bn/INR 30bn for FY27/FY28.
A weak print KNR reported a muted quarter with revenue of INR 4.8bn, flat YoY and EBITDA of INR 439mn (-18% YoY) with margin of 9.2% (-166bps YoY).
valuation: Notably, the awarding has improved recently, on the back of which, KNR is targeting INR 50bn order inflow (OI) in H2FY27.
The company is targeting INR 50bn OI in H2FY27, supported by improving order awarding.
We have trimmed our EPC multiple to 8x, from 10x earlier, on account of lower executable OB, multiple projects waiting for AD and higher composition of mining orders in the OB.
watch: While the OB appears robust, its high mining share and pending AD on new awards remain key risks to near-term execution.
The recipient should independently evaluate the investment risks.
